_doc: ADR-0069 D-E.6 / grill-t8 ledger D-006: the v3 contamination-registry FRAMEWORK, registered in the doc round before any v3 artifact exists. The T-3 freeze populates the v3 plan's contamination_registry with one row per registered parameter below; row shape mirrors the v1/v2 registry ({parameter, value, v2_informed, basis}) with the contamination axis shifted one generation. A value of null means 'registered at the T-3 freeze', never a placeholder number.

rows.basis: the conservative-transfer referent must be re-argued for a deterministic pairer (ADR-0069 D-E.3): 0.563863 was set for the LR port from mde-freeze; whether it transfers, tightens, or is re-derived is a T-3 registration, never a silent carry

0.10 was already v1-contaminated at v2; for v3 it is additionally v2-informed (the exit-report concentration failure is known); the product-semantic rationale stays physically separated from table arithmetic
